subject: se
question: Draw and explain a UML Sequence Diagram for a Library Management System showing the process of issuing a book (Student, Librarian, Library Management System).
title: Chat Between Three
hook: A sequence diagram is just a group chat: read it top to bottom and the order is the whole story.
answer: A sequence diagram shows how objects interact, in time order.
Three lifelines (dashed vertical lines): Student, Librarian, LMS (Library Management System).
Six messages top to bottom: requestBook(), isAvailable(), available (reply), issueBook(), confirm(dueDate) (reply), hands over book (reply).
Solid arrow = call/request, dashed arrow = reply.
Memory trick: the lifeline is the clock, the arrows are the words.
